items.summary: Recommendation: reject the proposed wetpages.com readiness report and authorize no new production, queue, financial, attribution, or causal-lift work this cycle. Existing telemetry is low-volume, aggregate commission is unattributed, zero improvements are proven, and measurement plus failed-request repair work remains open. Continue only existing measurement gates, failed-request repair or closure, private-gate controls, and bounded read-only revalidation. Decision: authorize only those existing bounded workstreams this cycle?
